item: A rising Lead needs 3 articles in 2 outlets, and says so when nothing qualifies (R732)
refs: PR pending; R732; field test 2026-11-14 row 64 (report 4.3 and 16.5)
summary: Every rising lead on eight field instances was one outlet's own wording or one article repeating a name: Tetum function words at n~7,370, a site's category label, 尼克松 at 404 mentions from one article. rising_now now reads 4x the candidates and shows a term only when its mentions in the last 7 days come from at least RISING_MIN_ARTICLES = 3 articles in at least RISING_MIN_OUTLETS = 2 outlets (outlets by OutletMap, quarantined articles left out, R101). The ratio still counts mentions; the card's summary, math rows and signal add the article and outlet counts, and its method states the floor. When candidates rose but none passed, one rising_held card in the Rising family says so (never a relaxed threshold), lists the narrow terms with their counts, and opens the articles they came from. 11 new strings in all 12 locales. The missing Tetum stopwords and the Arabic category label belong to the keywords stream.
